name: Fita
what: Tailor shops track orders, measurements, karigor work, payments and dues from the counter, the owner's phone and the workshop.
hard_part: Local-first sync: the whole shop lives in IndexedDB so a tap paints in about 30 ms, writes show at once as an optimistic overlay and wait in an offline queue, and the server filters every record per role so a karigor never receives prices, payments or customers' phone numbers.
status: Live · self-signup with 30-day trial and billing
demo_note: one-tap demo roles (owner, counter, karigor); each visitor gets a private sandbox shop
facts: Private demo sandbox seeded in about 150 ms per visitor
Prints 80 mm / 58 mm receipts, A5 memo and a price-free karigor slip
Automatic Bangla SMS for order taken, ready and reminders
